source.title: The Agent creation interface does not display Ollama as a model provider

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body: ## Describe the problem/error/question When attempting to create an agent, the list of models does not display Ollama as a provider, even though the Ollama server has been correctly configured and I am able to create Personal Agents and Workflow Agents powered by Ollama models. ## What is the error message (if any)? No error message is shown. ## Please share your workflow/screenshots/recording ### Agent creation ### Personal Agent working with Ollama models ### Model Providers Registred ## Debug info ### core - n8nVersion: 2.43.6 - platform: docker (self-hosted) - nodeJsVersion: 26.7.0 - nodeEnv: production - database: postgres - executionMode: regular - concurrency: -1 - license: enterprise (production) ### storage - success: all - error: all - progress: false - manual: true - binaryMode: filesystem ### pruning - enabled: true - maxAge: 336 hours - maxCount: 10000 executions ### client - userAgent: mozilla/5.0 (windows nt 10.0; win64; x64; rv:158.0) gecko/20100101 firefox/158.0 - isTouchDevice: false Generated at: 2026-10-15T17:59:21.735Z

comments.author: CloudCorpRecords
comments.text: Hi, I would like to work on this. Initial read: the agent creation interface builds its model provider list separately from the node credentials, and Ollama is missing from that list even though the Ollama chat model node ships with n8n. Plan: find where the provider list is assembled, add Ollama with the same metadata shape as the other local providers, and cover it with a test at the list level. Shout if the team is already on it internally (I see the Linear ticket) and I will stand down.
